sources.title: É. Gourgoulhon and J.-L. Jaramillo, A 3+1 perspective on null hypersurfaces and isolated horizons, Physics Reports 423 (2006), arXiv:gr-qc/0503113v2
sources.locator: Full 224-page PDF inspected. Relevant locators: §1.2.2 curvature sign; §§2.2 and 2.5–2.7 null hypersurfaces, generators, Weingarten map and second fundamental form; §4.4 cross-section metric; §§5.1 and 5.5–5.8 optical expansion, shear and boosts; §6.2 Raychaudhuri equation.

contents.name: §1.2.2 curvature convention
contents.support: Confirms the curvature sign used for the Jacobi and screen Riccati equations; the local proof states the library convention explicitly.

contents.name: §§2.2 and 2.5–2.7 null hypersurface generators, Weingarten map and second fundamental form
contents.support: Supplies geometric context for local null normals and the screen endomorphism; the local lemma proves bundle well-definedness, positivity, symmetry and boost behavior.

contents.name: §4.4 metric on cross-sections
contents.support: Supports the cross-section screen metric convention; the definition explicitly takes traces only on the positive quotient.

contents.name: §§5.1 and 5.5–5.8 optical expansion, shear and normal-frame boosts
contents.support: Supports optical notation and boost context; the exact scaling law is supplied and proved by the local helper.

contents.name: §6.2 null Raychaudhuri equation
contents.support: Provides the comparison result and non-affinity context; the item derives the affine specialization from the screen Jacobi equation and states the Ricci hypothesis explicitly.

source_review.read_extent: Full PDF inspected, including all listed sections and the surrounding derivations.
source_review.supports: Null screen geometry, optical variables, boost conventions, curvature sign and Raychaudhuri context for the listed local items.
source_review.limitations: The paper uses a different null-pair normalization in parts of its treatment and includes non-affinity terms; the local statements use g(ell,k)=-2 and an affine generator. It is not treated as proof of an unstated hypothesis.

sources.title: Edward Witten, Light Rays, Singularities, and All That, Clay Mathematics Institute lecture notes
sources.locator: Full 106-page PDF inspected. Relevant locators: §§5.2 and 5.4–5.5 focal points, promptness and null focusing; §§8.2 and 8.4 surface-origin null causal deformation and the index form; §8.5 Jacobi matrix and Raychaudhuri equation.

contents.name: §§5.2 and 5.4–5.5 focal points, promptness and null focusing
contents.support: Provides an independent treatment of null focusing; the item gives the complete Riccati, trace and comparison proof under its stated Ricci hypothesis.

contents.name: §§8.2 and 8.4 surface-origin causal deformation and the null index form
contents.support: The detailed local treatment motivates the exact null screen index form; the new A-page lemma derives the initial chi boundary term and second-variation identity completely.

contents.name: §8.5 Jacobi matrix and Raychaudhuri equation
contents.support: Supports the Jacobi-matrix interpretation and comparison route; the local argument derives the matrix equation and does not infer curvature blow-up.

contents.name: §§8.2 and 8.4 surface-origin causal deformation using the null index form
contents.support: The local focal proof uses the fully stated index-form supplier, constructs a negative direction and proves the longitudinal correction and push-up argument.

source_review.read_extent: Full PDF inspected, including the listed sections and the detailed local index-form discussion in §8.4.
source_review.supports: Independent lecture treatment of null focusing and the surface-origin second-variation argument for the listed items.
source_review.limitations: The focusing discussion in §5 is partly informal; the local proofs are complete and the focal exclusion proof uses the detailed §8 argument only as source context, not as a substitute for its derivation.
